content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: thejammyproject
  namespace: platform-apps
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: thejammyproject
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: thejammyproject
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: thejammyproject
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
        - name: website
          image: jammyuk/thejammyproject-website:v1.13@sha256:198268e2f0d7a49d5a46c52d87db0eec4f943f9e015db535350d96768d97aa34
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /, port: http }
            initialDelaySeconds: 3
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /, port: http }
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests: { cpu: 10m, memory: 16Mi }
            limits: { cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: thejammyproject
  namespace: platform-apps
spec:
  selector:
    app: thejammyproject
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: thejammyproject-internal
  namespace: platform-apps
spec:
  secretName: thejammyproject-internal-tls
  duration: 8760h
  renewBefore: 720h
  privateKey:
    algorithm: ECDSA
    size: 256
    rotationPolicy: Always
  dnsNames:
    - thejammyproject.internal
  issuerRef:
    name: local-platform-ca
    kind: Issuer
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: thejammyproject
  namespace: platform-apps
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
    - secretName: thejammyproject-internal-tls
      hosts:
        - thejammyproject.internal
  rules:
    - host: thejammyproject.internal
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: thejammyproject
                port:
                  number: 80
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: thejammyproject-ingress
  namespace: platform-apps
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: thejammyproject
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 80
